description:
***New to market with Tony Donnelly of Leonard Wilson Keenan***

This superb  5-bedroom detached bungalow at Churchtown Lodge, Churchtown, Co. Kildare is an exceptional, spacious family home. Occupying a private, generous site, the property boasts a fantastic attic conversion and a large detached garage/workshop, making it ideal for a growing family looking for versatility, comfort, and independence.

Key Features

•	Spacious Living: Detached bungalow design offering easy single-level living options with a spacious, flowing layout.
•	Versatile Attic Conversion: That includes two double bedrooms and a bathroom.
•	Detached Garage: Offers excellent extra storage, workshop potential, or a secure area for a classic car.
•	Prime Location: Situated in the peaceful setting of Churchtown, just a short distance from Athy town and all amenities, schools, shops, train station, swimming pool, and quick access to commuter routes.

Property Layout

Ground Floor

•	Entrance Hall: Bright, welcoming entrance hallway providing clear separation between living and bedroom spaces.
•	Living & Dining: Spacious rear extension with main lounge featuring large windows that flood the room with natural light, alongside an interconnected kitchen and dining space, laundry/utility room with shower unit, back hall and door to the rear garden area.

•	Additional Bedrooms: Three further double bedrooms offering flexible accommodation options for family members or guests.

•	Family Bathroom: A centrally located bathroom with separate shower unit.


First Floor

•	Attic Conversion: Accessed via a permanent staircase, this expansive, bright space features overhead skylights, creating an incredibly adaptable environment to fit your family’s unique needs.

Exterior  

•	Gardens & Grounds: The rear of the property features mature trees & shrubs and a south-facing cobble lock patio area.
•	Secure parking accessed via electric gates with tarmacadam drive 
•	Detached Garage: Positioned to the side, providing ample secure parking and extra utility storage space.
